proposition: The dissertation gives three descriptions of the copying span of MS Majlis 10196 that do not coincide: 'the last eight years of the author's life and three years past his death' (p.78; with death in 835/1432 that would be roughly 827-38), 'between 828-41/1425-37' (p.80), and a Mafāḥiṣ copy dated 823/1420 (p.97). The span cannot be fixed from these pages.
